title: Agents could not save cases for 34 minutes after REL-031
summary: A hotfix release registered an extra RepeatFaultPlugin step on Update of incident. The plug-in's registration guard threw on every case update, so saving any existing case failed in Cedar-Prod until the step was deactivated.

impact.customerFacing: Case updates and resolutions delayed; no data lost; new cases could still be created

events.text: REL-031 (CedarServiceCore 1.10.1) deployed by Cedar Release Pipeline
Omar reports 'Business process error' when saving CAS-01311
Karim takes the incident, opens Application Insights Failures
Two steps on RepeatFaultPlugin found in the solution: Create (correct) and Update (new)
Dana deactivates the Update step (runbook AL-12); saves succeed
AL-12 fires from the data export, 104 minutes after the start
REL-032 (1.10.2) removes the Update step and the unmanaged deactivation layer

rootCauses: The REL-031 solution contained a second SDK message processing step for RepeatFaultPlugin on Update, added while testing a fix in Cedar-Dev and exported with the solution.
The plug-in guard treats any unexpected registration as fatal, which turns a configuration mistake into a blocking error for every case save.
contributingFactors: The pull request diff showed the step only inside the unpacked customizations XML, which reviewers did not read.
The Cedar-Test UAT for REL-031 covered case creation only; no test updated an existing case.
AL-12 is based on the admin-center data export, whose delivery can lag; synchronous plug-in failures need minutes, not hours.

actions.text: Registration manifest check: build fails if plug-in steps differ from docs/plugins/registration.json (lesson 68 manifest)
ADR-024: guard logs and skips on unexpected message/stage in enrichment plug-ins; only validation plug-ins may block
Synthetic check: timer function in func-cedar-ops creates and updates a (test) case on site TST-A every 5 minutes as an application user; failure raises AL-12b within 10 minutes
UAT template always includes create, update and resolve of an existing case (E2E test added to C-62 suite)
